positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
◦ Contribute to a framework that helps other engineers write test cases for datacenter hardware
◦ Built and maintain a system that provides the correct machines for testing given 10,000+ of servers in the
datacenters
◦ Optimize concurrency code, allowing the server selection system to handle a larger pool of servers
◦ Provided unittest and type checking basis to the code base
◦ Build data visualization dashboards to summarize test results after a hardware qualification
◦ Use a combination of Python and bash scripting to triage hardware failure, which helps to find the root cause
◦ Develop tools in bash and Python to automate repetitive processes

positions.title: Contract Test Analyst
positions.description:
- Wrote test scripts that ensure the quality of Cisco routers
- Contribute to a framework that facilitates maintainable and modular test scripts
- Prepared, executed automation scripts and evaluated results

positions.title: Front-end Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Added features to a real-estate website that enhance usability
- Refactored existing source code for more succinct and reusable code
- Added back-end functions that perform resource-heavy tasks, which reduced load time
